title: Independent Restricted Surface-Evaporation Runtime Materialization Requalification

independence.oracle_strategy: closed-form result oracle plus an independent state-derived hydraulic-capacity provider over held-out state, demand and ponding combinations

required_checks: capacity provider receives exact detached committed physical base state
ponding threshold exact and just-above classification
negative finite capacity clamps dry evaporation to zero but remains diagnostic
invalid ET binding fails closed before capacity call
invalid capacity result fails closed before process publication
no mass-ledger mutation or second water booking
all 30 architecture invariants have no adverse delta within frozen scope

frozen_scope.time_semantics: trial-local materialization only; no accepted interval integration in this workunit

decision_rule: qualify only if all independent source, numerical, transaction and architecture checks pass on the exact immutable two-file candidate under O0 and O2
